m6_transfer.revision_diff_and_validity_reason: Grok PR #675 I/J scope was a distinct two-swap research candidate (+Arcane Signet/Mox Amber, +Bitterblossom/Windfall), NOT Cory's exact approved five-swap 70b48148 revision. Exact current 100 keeps Windfall, removes Magus of the Moon, Ashiok, Damping Sphere, Sheoldred, Mox Amber and adds Arcane Signet, Bitterblossom, Opposition, Phyrexian Altar, Ophiomancer. Blueprint cases referring to removed Damping, Magus and Sheoldred are deliberately re-adjudicated in C/K/E/W/F cases against changed realities, not falsely reused. 6 required P0 and 9 P1 source- and exact-hash-bound finite authored fixtures plus 100 identity/legality checks executed on engineering PR #705 head dca07c0, green CI 40175693250. No full multiplayer win-rate test or blanket earlier I/J certification is asserted.

P0.payable_fixture: Kraum printed {3}{U}{R}, opponent spell counts 2/3/1 in separate seats, controller has legal colored pips.
P0.positive_assertion: Exactly one draw for each opponent's second spell, flying/haste and Partner retained.
P0.adversarial_assertion: No trigger with only first spells or Kraum absent; colorless mana cannot replace U/R pips.

P0.payable_fixture: Tevesh printed {4}{B}, +2 produces two Thrulls and loyalty six; +1 sacrifices another permanent.
P0.positive_assertion: +1 draws two for noncommander, three for sacrificed commander; independent per-partner tax.
P0.adversarial_assertion: No other sacrificed permanent gives zero cards; recasting one partner does not tax the other.

P0.payable_fixture: Under retained Trinisphere, second opponent spell has paid three mana; Damping Sphere removed.
P0.positive_assertion: Paid second cast triggers Kraum despite a non-hard-cap tax.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Only one cast or only two available mana for a taxed one-mana spell gives no trigger.

P0.payable_fixture: Blood Moon and Phyrexian Tower on battlefield with a sacrificable Thrull and Phyrexian Altar.
P0.positive_assertion: Tower becomes nonbasic Mountain with red tap mana; Altar remains colored creature-sacrifice artifact.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Tower's original BB sacrifice ability does not remain under Moon; unavailable creature cannot pay Altar.

P0.payable_fixture: Chrome Mox/LED under untapped Trinisphere with Chalice charged at zero.
P0.positive_assertion: Zero mana-value spell costs three to cast but retains printed mana value zero for Chalice trigger.
P0.adversarial_assertion: With insufficient three mana it cannot be cast; a MV1 spell does not trigger Chalice set to zero.

P0.payable_fixture: Contamination land mana converts to black; Arcane Signet and Altar provide colored nonland sources to pay Opposition UU.
P0.positive_assertion: Two actual blue sources plus generic can pay Opposition {2}{U}{U}.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Zero or one blue source cannot pay both pips regardless of excess black/colorless.

P1.payable_fixture: Own Wishclaw activated during your turn with {1} paid; then a named opponent controls it under our Karn.
P1.positive_assertion: Our Wishclaw activated legally first, after transfer Karn disables opponent's artifact activation.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Opponent cannot activate it even with mana; no payment or wrong timing also rejects.

P1.payable_fixture: Breach/LED/Brain Freeze with Trinisphere and Chalice 0; Damping Sphere absent in exact source.
P1.positive_assertion: Without those restrictions LED's UUU can pay a Brain Freeze {1}{U} escape, with sufficient food.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Trinisphere requires 3 for LED and 3 for Freeze; lone LED UUU cannot pay both; Chalice 0 counters LED.

P1.payable_fixture: Tevesh +2 generated two real 0/1 Thrulls, Contamination upkeep sacrifice, then an Altar/Clamp/Tower choice.
P1.positive_assertion: One Thrull remains after paying upkeep; a second may be sacrificed once for mana or draw, Clamp kills 1/0.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Cannot sacrifice one creature three times; Ophiomancer does not trigger while a Snake persists.

P1.payable_fixture: Tap own Static/Winter Orb with Opposition before own untap; produce U via Arcane/Altar under Contamination.
P1.positive_assertion: Tapped Orb disables its untap limit for our step, own Orb re-enables after untap; noncreature abilities survive Cursed Totem.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Untapped Orb restricts to 1 land/2 permanents; Opposition 2UU unpayable with one U source.

P1.payable_fixture: Helm X=1, finite five-card opponent library and Leyline or Dauthi replacement, activation cost and tap paid.
P1.positive_assertion: Replacement exile sends no cards to graveyard and Helm processes all five; loss arises on later empty-library draw.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Without replacement effect Helm mills one for X=1, no immediate total exile or immediate automatic win.

P1.payable_fixture: Underworld Breach, LED UUU and Brain Freeze 1U, three other escape cards, original plus two storm copies.
P1.positive_assertion: First paid escape succeeds with adequate other cards; three Freeze instances mill nine total.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Two food cards or no blue source fails; LED activation discards hand, no phantom retained spells.

P1.payable_fixture: Kraum 4/4 flying haste with legal unblocked combat, Ragavan 2/1, token creature sources.
P1.positive_assertion: Six unblocked Kraum attacks to same opponent exceed 21 commander combat damage without Sheoldred.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Five Kraum attacks only 20 commander damage; blockers/removal may prevent combat clock, no automatic Sheoldred drain.

P1.payable_fixture: Artifact sweep destroys named locks and colored rocks while Bitterblossom enchantment and Ophiomancer creature remain.
P1.positive_assertion: Phyrexian Altar, Arcane Signet, Skullclamp and Winter Orb are removed; token engines can persist if not otherwise affected.
P1.adversarial_assertion: With artifacts destroyed, previously generated mana/lock asymmetry cannot be assumed; no guarantee engines survive broader sweep.

P1.payable_fixture: Breach/LED/Freeze, Chalice at zero and/or untapped Trinisphere, no Damping Sphere in exact 100.
P1.positive_assertion: The retained locks' cost/counter clauses are applied and the unrestricted casting cost restored if they are absent.
P1.adversarial_assertion: LED still has mana value zero under three-mana cast floor and triggers Chalice 0; no effortless loop under own locks.
